9:54 This is my favorite version of Firework. I've always liked it the most out of Katy's songs, and her half-time finale cements that. The mystical music in the beginning before transitioning into an orchestra, Katy flying on a shooting star, the fireworks bursting in the air, the audience singing along, acting like a choir, and Katy raising her arms in the air like she's on top of the world. I nearly teared up for how epic it was. And I've never used that word when describing her songs.
